question: In which year was the Shri Mahila SEWA Sahakari Bank established?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 2 - 1974**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Shri Mahila SEWA Sahakari Bank was established in **1974** in Ahmedabad, Gujarat.
 
• This bank was founded by the **Self-Employed Women’s Association (SEWA)**, a trade union for poor, self-employed women workers.
 
• The bank was formed with the aim to provide financial services to women workers in the informal sector, enabling them to become self-reliant.
 
• It is a unique initiative that focuses on empowering women economically by offering savings and credit facilities tailored to their needs.
 
• The bank operates under the principles of women’s empowerment and inclusivity, and it is owned and managed by women.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **SEWA (Self-Employed Women’s Association):**

 
 
• Founded in 1972 by social activist **Ela Bhatt** in Ahmedabad.
 
• It is a trade union that represents women workers in the informal sector.
 
• SEWA's mission is to organize women workers for their rights and to improve their working and living conditions.
 
 
 
• **Role of Cooperative Banks in India:**
 
 
• Cooperative banks are financial entities established on cooperative principles to serve specific communities.
 
• They focus on providing affordable credit to marginalized groups, especially in rural and semi-urban areas.
 
 
 
• **Financial Inclusion:**
 
 
• Financial inclusion refers to efforts to make financial products and services accessible and affordable to all individuals, especially the underprivileged.
 
• Initiatives like the SEWA Bank contribute significantly to promoting financial inclusion.
 
 
 
• **Ela Bhatt:**
 
 
• Ela Bhatt was a prominent social activist and founder of SEWA.
 
• She was internationally recognized for her work in women’s empowerment and was awarded several honors, including the **Ramon Magsaysay Award**.
